name: Rodic's Diner
address: G/F Epsilon Chi Center, Balagtas St. (near Cine Adarna / Bahay ng Alumni), UP Diliman, Quezon City
blurb: The legendary UP tapsilog stop: cheap, filling, and perfect after a long class day.

name: Gyud Food Hub (UP Diliman Food Hub)
address: Emilio Jacinto St. (across College of Fine Arts), UP Diliman, Quezon City
blurb: A roomy campus food hall with lots of stalls, from bacsilog to rice bowls, so the whole barkada can pick something different.

name: Mang Larry's Isawan
address: 28 Road 20, Bahay Toro, Project 8, Quezon City
blurb: The famous UP isaw grill found a new home here, same smoky skewers and tusok-tusok favorites.

name: Ka Tunying's
address: 88 Visayas Ave., Brgy. Vasra, Quezon City, 1128 Metro Manila
blurb: Pinoy comfort-food restaurant and bakery for tapa, longganisa and kakanin when you want a sit-down meal along Visayas Ave.

name: Gubat QC
address: 43 Mayaman St., Diliman (near UP Village / Maginhawa), Quezon City
blurb: Eat with your hands off banana leaves: lechon kawali and daing na pusit at fair prices in a leafy setting.

name: Art Circle Cafe
address: G/F Ang Bahay ng Alumni, Magsaysay Ave. cor. Balagtas St., UP Diliman, Quezon City
blurb: An art-filled campus cafe inside Bahay ng Alumni for pasta, quesadillas, rice meals and coffee between classes.

name: UP Area 2 food strip (J.P. Laurel St.)
address: J.P. Laurel St., Area 2, UP Campus, Diliman, Quezon City
blurb: Garage eateries and shake stands where a full lutong-bahay meal stays easy on a student budget.

name: Giyummy Korean Grill
address: 8 Visayas Ave., Diliman, Quezon City
blurb: Budget unli-samgyup spot for barkada dinners that run late; expect a wait at peak hours.

name: Friuli Trattoria
address: 79-A Maginhawa St., Teachers Village, Diliman, Quezon City
blurb: Long-running Maginhawa favorite for big, shareable pasta and pizza without the fancy-restaurant price.

name: Pino Resto Bar / Pipino Vegetarian
address: 39 Malingap St., Teachers Village East, Quezon City
blurb: Two restaurants in one house: Pinoy-fusion downstairs and a fully plant-based menu upstairs, great for mixed groups.

name: Roots Coffee & Craft
address: 75 Sampaguita Ave, Quezon City, 1107 Metro Manila (near Don Antonio / FEU Diliman)
blurb: Right on Sampaguita Ave, so it's the easiest walk from campus for good coffee and a calm study session.

name: Eleven & After Coffee and Cocktails
address: 13 Congressional Ave, Project 8, Quezon City, 1106 Metro Manila
blurb: A coffee and cocktails spot on Congressional Ave that stays open late, good for late-night study sessions over a latte.

name: Lotus Cafe
address: 38 General Ave, Bahay Toro, Project 8, Quezon City, 1116 Metro Manila
blurb: Comfy, pet-friendly cafe with lots of sockets and free WiFi, a solid laptop spot for long group work.

name: Brewing Point Neighborhood Cafe - Congressional Ave Ext
address: 56 T.M. Kalaw Ave cor. Congressional Ave Ext, Brgy Tandang Sora, Quezon City, 1116 Metro Manila (plus code M3F6+3G4)
blurb: A long-running neighborhood cafe near campus (since 2003), known for red velvet cake, big rice meals and coffee. Good for group hangouts.

name: Clouds Cafe
address: Visayas Ave (plus code M27V+RGH), Project 8, Quezon City, Metro Manila
blurb: A cloud-themed cafe on Visayas Ave with board games, fun for afternoon-to-night barkada hangouts.

name: Kape Na Pud
address: 75 General Ave, Tandang Sora, Quezon City, 1116 Metro Manila
blurb: A cozy, good-looking cafe off Tandang Sora. Popular for its cream cheese latte, cinnamon rolls and basque burnt cheesecake.

name: Small House Cafe
address: 15 Tandang Sora Ave, Talipapa, Quezon City, Metro Manila
blurb: Small, homey Korean-style cafe (eggbread, hotteok, coffee) with WiFi and sockets for quiet solo study.

name: TBC Cafe (The Big Cup) - Commonwealth Ave
address: Blk 236 Lot 9A-9B Don Mariano Marcos Ave (Commonwealth Ave), Santa Monica, Novaliches, Quezon City, 1117 Metro Manila (inside McDonald's Sta. Monica)
blurb: Open 24 hours along Commonwealth, a handy midnight coffee stop when you're pulling an all-nighter.

name: UP Academic Oval
address: University Avenue / Academic Oval, UP Diliman, Quezon City
blurb: A shaded 2.2 km loop around the Sunken Garden under old acacia trees. Cars are kept off on Sundays, so it's a favorite for morning runs. It closes during big exams like UPCAT.

name: Quezon Memorial Circle (jogging & bike loop)
address: Elliptical Road, Diliman, Quezon City
blurb: A big, free city park with jogging and bike paths around the shrine, plus new tennis courts and a skatepark. It's a short ride from campus.

name: Anytime Fitness Vasra Visayas Avenue
address: #47 Visayas Ave., Brgy. Vasra, Quezon City 1128
blurb: A 24/7 members' gym on Visayas Ave with cardio, free weights and TRX, so you can train before or after class. Staff hours are shorter, roughly 6am-10pm.

name: Fitness First Platinum TriNoma
address: Level 3, TriNoma, EDSA corner North Ave, Quezon City 1105
blurb: A full-service mall gym with cycling, boxing and group studios, a yoga space and a steam room. You can book a free one-day trial. Weekends open at 8 AM.

name: Power UP Climbing - Tandang Sora
address: 690 Tandang Sora Avenue (Road 1), Matandang Balara, Quezon City
blurb: The Philippines' oldest climbing gym (since 1994), near UP Diliman. It's no-frills, with top-rope, bouldering and a Moonboard. A day pass is about P500, plus shoe rental. Check their IG for today's hours.

name: Anytime Fitness Crossroad (Tandang Sora)
address: 610 Tandang Sora Ave., Sangandaan, Quezon City 1116
blurb: A 24-hour gym on Tandang Sora Ave with cardio and strength equipment, handy for late-night workouts.

name: Quezon Memorial Circle
address: Elliptical Road, Diliman, Quezon City, Metro Manila
blurb: Big free city park for jogging, biking, skating, food stalls and chill hangouts after class.

name: Timezone UP Town Center
address: Level 2 Phase 2, U.P. Town Center, Katipunan Ave., Brgy. UP Campus, Diliman, Quezon City
blurb: Arcade games, a six-lane bowling alley, karaoke rooms and bumper cars in one spot along Katipunan.

name: Timezone TriNoma
address: 4/F TriNoma, EDSA cor. North Ave., Quezon City
blurb: Short-lane bowling, karaoke booths, billiards and VR for a full barkada game night near North Ave.

name: Ninoy Aquino Parks and Wildlife Center
address: North Ave. cor. Agham Rd., Diliman, Quezon City (beside Quezon Memorial Circle)
blurb: Shady lagoon paths and rescued animals for a cheap, calm nature break right next to QMC.

name: UP Diliman Sunken Garden
address: East side of the Academic Oval (University Ave. / Osmeña Ave. loop), UP Campus, Diliman, Quezon City
blurb: Wide open lawn in the Academic Oval for picnics, frisbee and the yearly UP Fair.

name: La Mesa Ecopark
address: La Mesa Watershed, Brgy. Greater Lagro (near Fairview), District V, Quezon City
blurb: Forest trails, picnic spots and fresh air for a weekend nature trip north of campus. Free for QC residents with ID, P50 for others; closed Mondays.
